title: Signed not-all-equal reproduces itself on every level-k Sierpinski gasket
claim: On the level-k Sierpinski gasket SG_k (copies of a three-bit law on the k(k+1)/2 up triangles of a k-subdivided triangle, corners a = (i, j), b = (i+1, j), c = (i, j+1), every vertex but the three corners summed), signed not-all-equal w = (-1)^((a xor b)(a xor c)) - [a = b = c] = (-1)^a ((a+b+c)|3) = (-1)^a sin(pi E/3)/sin(pi/3) (E the sum of (-1)^x over the tuple; the product of the Eisenstein field in the basis of primitive sixth roots, a as output) has corner relation lambda_k w for every k >= 1, with lambda_k an integer congruent to (-1)^floor(k/2) modulo 3, hence nonzero. Proof: each copy splits into two phase sectors; the gasket's bottom row and left side lock the sectors of the three corner triangles, and flipping every sector is odd; modulo 3 the corner relation is (-1)^N w because the only even edge sets of the reduced expansion are the empty set, the bottom row and the left side. The same identity holds for every w_theta = (-1)^a sin(theta E)/sin(theta) with sin(theta) nonzero, lambda_k(theta) a Laurent polynomial in e^(i theta) with finitely many zeros; signed not-all-equal is the only member whose support is a knot (knotlab: K1-K3). Hence signed not-all-equal builds an exact tower of every level k, of similarity dimension log(k(k+1)/2)/log k.
failure_conditions: A level k whose corner relation is not proportional to w, or whose factor is zero or not congruent to (-1)^floor(k/2) modulo 3.
A tuple on which the closed forms of w disagree.
A value of theta with sin(theta) nonzero and a level k at which the corner relation of w_theta is not proportional to w_theta.
An edge set of the kind used modulo 3, with even degree at every vertex but the corners, other than the empty set, the bottom row and the left column.
foundation_claim_scope: Signed three-bit laws on the level-k Sierpinski gaskets (finite gadgets for every k, and the towers they generate level by level); exactness of the corner relation; the knot status of its support under K1-K3.

validation.status: checked: closed forms on all tuples (Legendre symbol, sine, Eisenstein phases and product, row matrices); exactness by exact integers for k = 1 to 14; the sector formula for k <= 7; the family w_theta at six angles for k <= 7 and symbolically for k = 2, 3; the mod-3 relation for k <= 21; the edge-set lemma for k <= 4; knotlab K1-K3 on the support; controls fire; the proof for every k is in proof.md; no human or external review
